description: Blask, the living glare of sunlit amber, a blazing burst of golden-orange light shaped like a sharp-rayed star with a fierce glowing face in its centre, rays like blades, small amber shards orbiting it, an abstract creature of light, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, floating, full body, the creature alone, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
